Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
tetragr...@my-deja.com wrote:
>
> I was reading that Psyche is
> played after the combat is over,
> even if it is a combat card.
> That's allright, but
> how it works if someone plays an
> Hidden Lurker or a Fast Reaction
> (or maybe both are played by respectives Methuselas)?

If Psyche is played to start another combat involving
the acting and blocking minions, then another combat
starts immediately - before Hidden Lurker or Fast
Reaction can be played.

Once that combat is over, Hidden Lurker can be played
as normal. If it is not, then Fast Reaction could be
played as normal.

> There's here a chanche to see a combat involving
> three or more minions/vampires?

No.

> A question already presented in a prevoius thread:
> the lacking of specific cards against the (non Camarilla)
> Ravnos is intentional or it was an error in the Dark Sovereign
> card list?

The card list is correct.
